title: Seasonal Paper Products and Tableware Supplier Achieves 26% Unit Sales Lift with ReposiTrak Touchless Retail™ Merchandising
summary: SALT LAKE CITY, November 12, 2026--ReposiTrak, Inc. (NYSE: TRAK), the leader in retail supply chain, merchandising, compliance and traceability solutions, today announced that a seasonal paper products and tableware supplier achieved a 26% increase in unit sales while utilizing ReposiTrak's Touchless Retail™ merchandising services. The results demonstrate the potential of high-quality, consistent in-store execution to improve sales performance while substantially reducing merchandising costs.
